class Solution:
    def maximumOr(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:

        # If we can apply the operation on all elements,
        # the minimum value of nums[0] | nums[1] |... | nums[n - 1]
        # will be 0.
        if k >= n:
            return 0
        
        # Sort the array in ascending order
        nums.sort()
        
        # Initialize two pointers: left and right
        left, right = 0, n - 1
        
        while left <= right:
            mid = (left + right) // 2
            
            # Check if applying the operation on all elements
            # up to index mid yields a valid result
            if k >= mid:
                maxOr = nums[mid] | nums[mid + 1] | ... | nums[n - 1]
                
                # If the maximum OR value is greater than or equal to the target,
                # we can apply the operation on all elements up to index mid.
                if maxOr >= nums[0]:
                    k -= mid
                    right = mid - 1
                else:
                    left = mid + 1
            
            else:
                left = mid + 1
        
        return nums[0] | (nums[1] << 1) | ... | (nums[n - 1] << (k * 2))
